background: Barclays Bank PLC is the non-ring-fenced bank of Barclays, housing the corporate and investment bank, the international cards business and the private bank, funded by corporate deposits and wholesale markets.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026, the operating bank sits above its holding company. Leverage of 5.5% is in the top quarter of UK majors, but CET1 of 12.6% and NSFR of 112% are both in the bottom quarter, and LCR of 140% is below the peer median. LCR has fallen 14 points since 30 Jun 2025, while CET1, leverage and NSFR have been broadly flat. Flagged news in the last 90 days centres on the MFS collapse and the fraud allegations around it, the newest on 28 Sep 2026.
